description: This file defines the PregMatchFlags class with static methods for handling PHP regex match flags and match types, including type analysis and manipulation.

classes.name: PregMatchFlags
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to determine regex match types and manipulate match type representations in PHPStan analysis context.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the PHPStan type representing regex flags based on a provided argument and scope.

methods.name: removeNullFromMatches
methods.description: Removes null type from a given match type, traversing and transforming the type structure.
